svg.title: MoE expert offload
svg.text: MOE EXPERT OFFLOAD — HOW AN 18 GB MODEL RUNS IN AN 8 GB SLICE
amber = expert FFN layer (big, but each token uses only a few)

g.text: Whole 30B model on GPU = 18 GB → does NOT fit ✕
Move ALL experts to CPU → only 1.4 GB, always loads (8.6 tok/s)
Bring the first 14 of 48 back → 7.64 GB, just under the cap, 2× faster
